blocks.label: Practice
blocks.instructions:
Contact Identification — PracticeMultiple contacts appear on the bearing strip each round.
  • Click any contact to investigate it — its acoustic signature appears on the waterfall
  • Compare the signature to the Alpha reference shown below the SELECT button
  • A yellow box marks the contact you are currently viewing
  • If you find Alpha, click SELECT to report it (+100 pts)
  • If no contact matches Alpha, click DEFER to pass
  • Selecting a non-Alpha contact: -100 pts. Missing Alpha by deferring: -50 pts.

blocks.label: Main Task
blocks.instructions:
Contact IdentificationAbout 1 in 3 rounds contains an Alpha contact.
  • SELECT if you find Alpha (+100 pts). DEFER if you do not.
  • Selecting a non-Alpha: -100 pts. Missing Alpha by deferring: -50 pts. Correct DEFER: 0 pts.
  • Signatures are noisy — compare carefully to the Alpha reference below SELECT.
